ZoomedScene

Source: R/camera_moving.R
ZoomedScene.Rd

A MovingCameraScene with a second camera whose view is shown in a display in a corner of the screen. Call activate_zooming() to show the zoomed camera frame and its display, then move self$zoomed_camera$frame. The display is drawn as vector graphics clipped to the display rectangle rather than as a pixel copy of the zoomed camera.

Value

An R6 class generator. A scene class inherits from it, and $new() creates a scene.

Details

Initializer arguments (override initialize() in a subclass to change them): zoomed_display_height, zoomed_display_width, zoomed_display_center (overrides the corner), zoomed_display_corner, zoomed_display_corner_buff, zoomed_camera_config (list of MovingCameraClass arguments), zoomed_camera_image_mobject_config, zoomed_camera_frame_starting_position, zoom_factor (zoomed frame size over display size, 0.15), image_frame_stroke_width and zoom_activated.

Examples

UseZoomedScene <- R6::R6Class("UseZoomedScene", inherit = ZoomedScene, public = list(
  construct = function() {
    dot <- Dot()$set_color(GREEN)
    self$add(dot)
    self$wait(1)
    self$activate_zooming(animate = FALSE)
    self$wait(1)
    self$play(dot$animate$shift(LEFT))
  }))
# The last frame as a PNG file in the session's temporary directory.
render(UseZoomedScene, quality = "l", format = "png", media_dir = tempdir())
#> INFO File ready at '/tmp/RtmpwjjHXv/images/manimR/UseZoomedScene_manimR_v0.1.0.png'
#> INFO Rendered UseZoomedScene
#> Played 3 animations
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# A video in the media folder (by default in the session's temporary
# directory); this needs ffmpeg.
render(UseZoomedScene, quality = "l")
} # }
